other_conditions: Bonafide student of a recognized university/institution in India or abroad.
Under‑graduate students must have completed/appeared in the second year or 4th semester and secured at least 85% (or equivalent) in 12th class.
Graduate students must have completed/appeared in the first year or 2nd semester of their postgraduate programme or be pursuing research/PhD and secured at least 70% in graduation.
Students who have completed graduation/post‑graduation and are awaiting admission may be considered if they have a cumulative 70% or higher marks up to the date of application.
The gap between result declaration and the start of the internship must not exceed six months.
Applicants must apply at least two months in advance for the desired internship month.
Interns must have their own laptop.
Interns must maintain at least 75% attendance during the internship.
Interns must produce original mark sheets and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their college/institution at the time of joining.
Internship period must be at least six weeks and not exceed six months.
Applications are accepted online only between the 1st (00:00 hrs) and 10th (23:59 hrs) of each month.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a certificate of completion and gain practical exposure to NITI Aayog’s policy work.
